findings.body: The stub accepts `thread/attachment/add`, but no test calls `codex.attach` or reaches this driver branch. The request could be removed, its identity or payload changed, or its failure handling broken without failing the suite. Add coverage through `codex.attach` and the real SDK driver, faking the app-server, for the recorded thread, pinned fields, missing conversation, and request failure.
findings.title: Not done: attachment request tests
